svg.aria-label: jetpack: parallel gzip on JDK 25 reaches 422 megabytes per second against 66.2 single-threaded, a 6.4 times speedup, with blocks held in a bounded in-flight window drawn here as a running conveyor. Its hand-vectorised Adler-32 checksum runs at 4.26 gigabytes per second, 2.80 times the scalar baseline's 1.52, and is verified bit-identical against java.util.zip — whose own native intrinsic is faster still, at 14.06, and is printed here as the reference it loses to.
svg.title: jetpack — 6.4x parallel, and the intrinsic it does not beat
